description: Not decided; after the staples. Bonds and families: birds that eat near each other become pals and travel together; rivals chase each other off feeders; a bonded pair nests (in a tree, once trees exist); chicks follow a parent and inherit looks and traits (each trait with a chance per parent). The biggest attachment payoff and the biggest build. Memory: a favorite feeder, a rival, the player's attention (a bird you follow or name grows used to you). The chronicle: a journal in the cabin recording notable moments in the house voice (firsts, rare visitors, last visits, pairs, hatchings, the first rainbow), doubling as a life list and collecting the birds' event records.
title: Bonds, memory and the chronicle
